request.system: You are a sceptical results reviewer. Task: rank Medicare providers for audit. Each of 5,410 providers carries a PotentialFraud label (9.35% flagged) whose origin is undocumented; treat it as suspicion, not confirmed fraud. Claims run 27 Nov 2008 to 31 Dec 2009. The primary metric is PR-AUC; the audit queue holds about 100 providers. Pick the configuration to carry forward. Prefer a simpler model unless a more complex one is better by more than one standard deviation of PR-AUC across folds. Flag any result that looks too good. You may request up to 2 more round(s) of experiments; set stop=true if further search is unlikely to help. (Independent run 3.)

concerns: Run 3 (LightGBM, all+agent) leads on PR-AUC by 0.0338 over run 2, which is less than one fold SD (about 0.062). By the simplicity rule this is not a clear win, so the simpler random forest (run 2) is preferred. Logistic run 1 is simpler still but trails run 2 by 0.024, also within one SD.
All four runs fall within about 0.06 of each other, which is roughly one SD. The ranking is mostly noise, and with 9.35% prevalence each fold holds only about 100 positives.

ROC-AUC of 0.94 and PR-AUC of 0.68-0.74 are high for an undocumented label. The label may be rule-derived or leak through claim volume or reimbursement features. Treat it as suspicion, not confirmed fraud.
The size features (13) may act as a proxy for the label. Dropping them cost little (run 1 vs run 2 is confounded by model), so check whether the signal is real or just provider volume.
Agent features are aggregates over agents and may leak across folds if providers share agents. Verify that the CV splits are grouped by agent before trusting run 3's gain.
Precision@50 is about 0.75-0.80, but the queue holds 100 providers. Precision@100 is not reported and is the operationally relevant figure.
Comparisons are confounded: run 4 changes model, feature set, imbalance and params at once. There is no clean ablation, and run 3 is the only one using imbalance=none.
Dependence on the time window (Nov 2008 to Dec 2009) is untested. There is no temporal holdout.

next_experiments.rationale: Isolates the agent-feature effect with the same RF as run 2. If the gain persists, it comes from the features rather than from LightGBM.
Tests the simplest baseline with size features included, to measure the size proxy effect against run 1.
Run 3 without agent features, to separate the model effect from the agent-feature effect.
